The Mac (node 25e490e4) dispatched challenge session 01a1cf93-be8e-72a2-87a9-5cf0f86d75fc at 06:45:28 EST (h9kd.log: DraftChallengeEngine \\u0027challenge session ... dispatched\\u0027) and its verdict landed at 06:48 (publish as revised, 0 must, 1 should, 0 park; report ~/.hall9k/runs/01a1cf93-be8e-72a2-87a9-5cf0f86d75fc/challenge-report.md). The plan then applied a revision at 06:51 and published. At 08:10 a \\u0027challenge failed: another node dispatched it and recorded no outcome past the foreign-session ceiling\\u0027 entry was recorded against the same run and report, and the feed delivered \\u0027challenge ended with no verdict ... challenge again with h9k task challenge\\u0027 at 08:14. The Mac\\u0027s h9kd.log has no line for that failure, so another node of this owner recorded it. h9k task show 4bc02553 now shows Challenge \\u0027failed\\u0027 next to \\u0027Verdict on record ... the draft was revised since\\u0027. Harmless on a Done task, but on a live draft it would tell the operator to re-challenge (spending a session) a draft whose verdict exists, and plan drafts may hit the same. Find which condition the sweep reads as \\u0027no outcome\\u0027 (possibly the revision after the verdict, or the verdict event not reaching the other node before its ceiling) and make the sweep skip a challenge whose dispatching node recorded a verdict.
